mechanism: Quinidine inhibits CYP3A4 and CYP2D6, potentially increasing ethinyl estradiol plasma concentrations and enhancing estrogenic effects; ethinyl estradiol may induce hepatic metabolism affecting quinidine clearance.
action: Monitor for increased estrogenic side effects (nausea, breast tenderness, thromboembolic risk) and quinidine efficacy; consider alternative contraception or arrhythmia agent if adverse effects occur.
